Hello, I'm Wahid.

I am a software engineer with a strong focus on frontend development and product experience. Over the years, I’ve worked on building responsive, clean, and user-friendly web applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frameworks like React.js, Next.js, and Astro.

I’ve also taken on responsibilities beyond development including product management, shaping feature workflows, and improving user journeys. I enjoy transforming ideas into real, functional experiences and making sure the product is both effective and easy to use.

Along the way, I’ve created GIFs, explainer videos, and visual content to demonstrate product workflows and simplify complex concepts for users and teams.

I love building intuitive interfaces, optimizing performance, and continuously learning new tools and techniques to create better digital experiences.
